title: Trade Cherry
author: Puzzleheaded-City497
selftext:
After getting frustrated with switching between spreadsheets, notes and different apps, I decided to build \*\*Trade Cherry\*\*.    
The goal wasn’t to create another journal full of features you’ll never use. It was to build something that helps traders see what’s actually working.    
So far it includes:    
P&L calendar    
Trade journal    
Multiple prop firm account tracking    
Performance analytics    
Playbooks    
News calendar    
Trading calculators    
AI trade reviews (Ultra)    
Pricing is:    
\*\*Free\*\* – £0    
\*\*Trade Cherry\*\* – $30/month    
\*\*Ultra Cherry\*\* – $50/month    
The free version gives you everything you need to get started, and the paid plans are for traders managing multiple accounts or wanting deeper analytics.    
I’m still improving it every week, so I’d genuinely appreciate honest feedback from other traders. What would make you switch from your current journal?
